messages:
maria: Heads-up: prelaunch SEO + routing stand. Need a compact ops checklist we can hand to eng tonight. Main areas: CTAs/UTMs, redirects, schema for webinar + speakers, internal anchor map, and GTM conversion events. Can we scope?

devin: i'll draft a minimal mapping for UTMs -> HubSpot fields. proposal: utm_source=launch_post, utm_medium=social, utm_campaign=launch_q2_2026, utm_content={cta_variant}. keep lowercase.

ashley: on schema: minimal JSON-LD for webinar + speaker that eng can paste. example: 
```
{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Event","name":"Redwood Launch Webinar","startDate":"2026-04-07T17:00:00Z","eventStatus":"https://schema.org/EventScheduled","organizer":{"@type":"Organization","name":"Redwood Inference","url":"https://redwood.ai"},"performer":[{"@type":"Person","name":"Alex Kim"},{"@type":"Person","name":"Priya Rao"}],"url":"https://redwood.ai/webinar"}
```
Include speaker bios later.

omaria: quick note: we need FAQ schema too for SEO snippets. keep Q/A limited to 6 items max.

olivia: for forms -> hubspot mapping i can own. requirement: hidden fields: utm_campaign, utm_source, utm_content, page_path, referrer. webhook endpoint: /hooks/hubspot/launch. need sample POST body for eng.

devin: sample payload for webhook: {"email":"{{email}}","firstName":"{{first_name}}","utm_campaign":"{{utm_campaign}}","page":"/launch","lead_type":"marketing_winback"} (will tailor fields).

sam: redirects: we should prioritize top 30 legacy slugs by organic traffic. prefer 301 except for temporary promos where 302 is fine. I can export top slugs from GA and list.

ashley: practical redirect snippet for Netlify: 
```
/old-product  /product-new  301!
/promos/spring  /launch?utm_content=spring 302
```
Add comment: test with curl -I to confirm 301/302.

maria: internal linking: aim to link blog launch post -> docs on performance tuning, and docs -> pricing CTA. create anchor text list with exact phrases we want to rank on (e.g., "low-cost inference", "dedicated GPU pools"). sam can produce CSV: source,page_anchor,target.

sam: will include priority and PV threshold in CSV (high > 5k pv/mo). will also flag pages missing canonical.

devin: canonical enforcement: two parts: template <link rel=\"canonical\"> and header for CDN / edge. example nginx header: add_header Link "<https://redwood.ai/launch>; rel=canonical" always;

olivia: acceptance criteria for forms: sample lead created in HubSpot with utm fields present, and test webhook logged in devhooks. i'll run test by EOD.

seo-bot: reminder: update sitemap.xml after redirects, and resubmit to Search Console. scheduled crawl recommended 24-48h after deploy.

maria: timeline: devin -> UTMs & webhook snippet by 11:30. ashley -> schema + JSON-LD FAQ by 16:00. sam -> anchor CSV + redirect list by 16:00. olivia -> HubSpot mapping + test by 18:00. i'll stitch into a single checklist doc and ping eng for deploy.

devin: also add a dataLayer key launch_variant for A/B variant and event name launch_cta_click. use GA4 event naming conventions.

ashley: small SEO copy ask: please include exact H1 and meta description suggestion for landing page in checklist (editable). sample H1: "Redwood Inference: Production-Grade LLM Serving" meta desc: "Ship LLM features with predictable latency and cost. Join our launch webinar to learn how."

maria: great. final: add one paste-ready redirect file and one paste-ready JSON-LD snippet into the checklist so eng can copy/paste. i'll own the final handoff. :rocket:

seo-bot: automated note: run Lighthouse mobile perf on /launch and /blog/launch_path after deploy. set threshold tti < 3.5s.

maria: thanks — standup in 30 for any blockers.
